column2: The elevator is broken. Is there another way upstairs?
column3: Guba ang elevator. Naa bay laing agianan paingon sa taas?

column2: We need two more chairs, but we don't need another table.
column3: Kinahanglan pa mi og duha ka lingkuranan, pero dili na mi kinahanglan og laing lamesa.

column2: Please charge me 165 pesos, not 195.
column3: Palihog singli ko og 165 pesos, dili 195.

column2: I need to be at the port by 6:45 tomorrow morning.
column3: Kinahanglan naa na ko sa pantalan inig alas 6:45 ugma sa buntag.

column2: My sister left her wallet in the taxi.
column3: Nabilin sa akong igsoong babaye ang iyang pitaka sa taxi.

column2: The ferry from Ormoc was delayed by 30 minutes.
column3: Nalangan og 30 minutos ang barko gikan sa Ormoc.

column2: Don't go to Gate 8. Our gate is Gate 3.
column3: Ayaw adto sa Gate 8. Ang atong gate kay Gate 3.

column2: I need the bill, but we aren't ready to leave.
column3: Kinahanglan nako ang bill, pero dili pa mi andam molakaw.

column2: I said no sugar in the coffee.
column3: Miingon ko nga ayaw butangi og asukar ang kape.

column2: If the ferry is canceled, we'll stay in Cebu tonight.
column3: Kung makanselar ang biyahe sa barko, magpabilin mi sa Cebu karong gabii.

column2: We aren't staying at the hotel next to the bank.
column3: Wala mi nagpuyo sa hotel nga tapad sa bangko.

column2: This is my first time in Dumaguete.
column3: Mao ni ang una nakong pag-adto sa Dumaguete.

column2: I don't have cash. Do you accept a card?
column3: Wala koy kuwarta nga cash. Modawat ba mo og card?

column2: The child is asleep, so please speak quietly.
column3: Natulog ang bata, busa palihog hinayi ang imong tingog.

column2: Are these seats taken, or can we sit here?
column3: Gigamit na ba ning mga lingkoranan, o pwede mi molingkod dinhi?

column2: I'll text you as soon as the bus arrives.
column3: Mo-text ko nimo inig abot sa bus.

column2: I can understand some Cebuano, but I can't speak it well.
column3: Makasabot ko og gamay nga Cebuano, pero dili ko maayo mosulti niini.

column2: Does the price already include the 50 peso delivery fee?
column3: Apil na ba sa presyo ang 50 pesos nga bayad sa delivery?

column2: We booked the room for May 21, not May 12.
column3: Nagpareserba mi sa kuwarto para sa Mayo 21, dili Mayo 12.

column2: If they don't have rice, I'll order noodles instead.
column3: Kung wala silay kan-on, noodles na lang ang akong i-order.

column2: The charger is inside the small pocket on the left.
column3: Naa ang charger sa gamay nga bulsa sa wala.

column2: Can you write the address down for me?
column3: Pwede nimo isulat ang adres para nako?

column2: The sign says the shop opens at 10:15.
column3: Nakasulat sa karatula nga moabli ang tindahan sa alas 10:15.

column2: Please don't close the window. It is still hot in here.
column3: Palihog ayaw sirhi ang bintana. Init pa dinhi.

column2: I called three times, but nobody answered.
column3: Katulo ko mitawag, pero walay mitubag.

column2: I'm not asking for a refund. I just want a replacement.
column3: Wala ko nangayo nga ibalik ang bayad. Gusto lang ko og kapuli.

column2: We got off at the wrong stop and had to walk back.
column3: Ninaog mi sa sayop nga hunonganan ug kinahanglang maglakaw pabalik.

column2: The food was good, but the soup was too salty.
column3: Lami ang pagkaon, pero parat kaayo ang sabaw.

column2: Please don't throw away the receipt. I need it tomorrow.
column3: Palihog ayaw ilabay ang resibo. Kinahanglan nako kini ugma.

column2: Is the water from this tap safe to drink?
column3: Luwas ba imnon ang tubig gikan niini nga gripo?

column2: I brought an umbrella in case it rains later.
column3: Nagdala ko og payong basin moulan unya.

column2: We already paid for the tickets online.
column3: Nakabayad na mi sa mga tiket online.

column2: The bag with the red strap is mine.
column3: Akoa ang bag nga naay pulang higot.

column2: The doctor said to come back on Monday, not Wednesday.
column3: Miingon ang doktor nga mobalik sa Lunes, dili sa Miyerkoles.

column2: Could you turn the music down a little?
column3: Pwede nimo hinayan og gamay ang musika?

column2: If you're free, let's get something to eat after work.
column3: Kung libre ka, mangaon ta human sa trabaho.

column2: My flight leaves at 7:20, but boarding starts at 6:50.
column3: Molarga ang akong eroplano sa alas 7:20, pero magsugod ang pagsakay sa alas 6:50.

column2: I did not order shrimp. I'm allergic to it.
column3: Wala ko mo-order og pasayan. Aduna koy alerhiya niini.

column2: Could you speak up? I can't hear you over the rain.
column3: Pwede nimo kusgan ang imong tingog? Dili ko kadungog nimo tungod sa ulan.

column2: I thought the meeting was today, but they moved it to Thursday.
column3: Abi nako karon ang miting, pero gibalhin nila kini sa Huwebes.
